narrative: The impairment charge is £10.8M year to date against £5.4M in the plan; FY2026 cost of risk is forecast at 30 bps against 15 bps. Development finance stage 2 rose from 9.8% to 16.4% as four South East & East schemes (£52M) migrated after slower sales and 9% higher build costs. Other portfolios are on plan. Scenario weights are 40% base, 25% upside, 25% downside and 10% severe.
